name: Partial Region Growing for Transfer Function Generation
aliases: Partial Region Growing for Transfer Function Derivation
Partial Region Growing with Derived Transfer Functions
Transfer function derivation from region growing
definition: Performing region growing on only a subset of the volume or a small subset of regions to construct a classifier (2D transfer function) for visualizing the overall features, reducing computation time compared to full region growing.
summary: Partial Region Growing for Transfer Function Generation is a semi-automatic technique that derives a 2D transfer function from a partially segmented region to visualize similar, disconnected features throughout the entire volume.
